tooltipBidBiddingProcess: Bidding process:[BR]You can place bids on items you're interested in.[BR]You must bid at least the minimum amount to outbid the current bid.

tooltipBidAuctionDuration: Auction duration:[BR]If the remaining auction time is less than 05:00, the duration extends to 05:00 when the highest bidder changes.
tooltipBidWinning: Winning:[BR]The highest bidder when the auction ends wins the item.

tooltipAuctionsTips: Tips:[BR]Items tend to sell better during popular gaming hours[BR]Time your auctions to end during peak player activity[BR]Check similar items to understand market prices
